publicApproval.scope: Parent-approved public derivatives of this exact real canvas review; not production, compiler, complete-application or runtime certification.
publicApproval.parentReview: Parent read complete redacted MAIN and both provenance records, verified fourteen pins and performed scoped restricted-context/private-binding/URL/email/credential screening with zero matches.
publicApproval.siteReview: Normal derivative visual/privacy review of the eight approved images. Site author did not inspect private originals or independently repeat the original-to-derivative pixel comparison.
publicApproval.bodyPolicy: All four TXT files, including BOM, complete coverage, claims, quotes, redactions and footer/unavailable records, remain byte-identical to the approved inputs.
publicApproval.imagePolicy: All eight image payloads remain byte-identical. Four user-provided images are not TEST captures; their capture times remain unknown.
publicApproval.deliveryBoundary: One guarded SendEmailV2 succeeded. Original owner Inbox receipt and recipient containment remain unverified after observed forwarding/autoreply. The user-provided notification body is not proof of verified Inbox receipt or single delivery.
publicApproval.hostingBoundary: Public derivative approval is distinct from hosting/deployment; hosting state is recorded separately in content.json.
